note: Buying and reweighting are portfolio operations, not isolated swaps: /buy shows what funds it (cash first, then a bounded trim of what you hold), flags cross-chain legs and shortfalls, and states the share it leaves; /reweight expresses a target as buy/sell deltas against your real book including exits to zero. Both name the Spectrum Portfolio batcher as the one-transaction path and switch to it automatically once PORTFOLIO_BATCHER_ADDRESS is set.
